name: Ethan Riley
title: Junior Game Developer
summary: Motivated Junior Game Developer with a passion for creating immersive and engaging interactive experiences. Possessing a strong foundation in game engine development, object-oriented programming, and collaborative project execution. Eager to contribute to dynamic teams and push the boundaries of game design and technology.

bullets: Implemented core gameplay mechanics and UI features for an unannounced PC title using C# and Unity, contributing to a 15% improvement in player tutorial completion rates.
Optimized asset loading times and memory usage across several game levels, resulting in a 10% reduction in load screen duration.
Collaborated with a team of 5 designers and artists to integrate new features, ensuring seamless cross-departmental workflow.
Developed and debugged C++ scripts for AI behavior and character movement in an Unreal Engine 5 project.
Assisted in the creation of visual effects and particle systems, enhancing environmental immersion.
Participated in daily stand-ups and sprint reviews, providing technical insights and progress updates.
Designed and prototyped 3 unique game concepts from conception to playable demos using Unity, focusing on innovative mechanics.
Managed all aspects of development including programming, asset integration, and basic sound design for personal projects.
Utilized version control (Git) to track changes and collaborate on a small open-source game jam entry.
